# truenas_snapshot_task_run (Action)

Runs a periodic snapshot task immediately (pool.snapshottask.run).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Trigger an on-demand run of a periodic snapshot task (Terraform 1.14+).
action "truenas_snapshot_task_run" "example" {
  config {
    id = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Periodic snapshot task id (truenas_periodic_snapshot.<name>.id).
